title: ci: add per-prompt metrics hook for prompt-regression gating
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: We currently gate PRs for model/prompt regressions at the per-eval-suite level. This PR adds a CI hook and lightweight server-side metrics collector that produces per-prompt metrics (accuracy, BLEU, ROUGE-L where applicable, and a simple confidence calibration delta) and folds those into the existing prompt-regression gating flow. The goal is to provide faster, finer-grained signal so that regressions affecting a small-but-critical subset of prompts surface earlier and with clear attribution.

What this PR does: Implements a new CI hook (scripts/ci/per_prompt_metrics_hook.py) that runs after eval-harness completes, extracts per-prompt results, computes summary stats and deltas against baseline snapshots stored in S3, and uploads a small JSON payload to the gating service. Adds a short-lived local server (tools/prompt_metrics_collector/) used by CI to aggregate results and retry transient failures. Integrates with the existing gating rule evaluator to allow thresholds to be defined per-prompt or per-prompt-group in the gating config (ci/gating/per_prompt_thresholds.yaml).

Checklist: - [x] Per-prompt extractor and metric computation implemented - [x] CI hook wired into GitHub Actions workflow - [x] Baseline snapshot fetch + delta computation implemented - [x] Backwards-compatible gating evaluator changes - [x] Unit tests and integration test for the hook - [x] Docs: short how-to in docs/ci/per_prompt_metrics.md

Testing and validation: Unit tests added under tests/ci/ covering extractor edge cases and delta computation. Integration run executed on a staging branch against a small prompt set (50 prompts) and compared to historical baselines; observed correct delta computation and no false positives after tuning default thresholds. Load tests show the collector server can handle 250 concurrent small payloads without queueing.

Rollout plan: Merge to main -> enable hook on staging for two weeks -> monitor false positive/negative rate and gating noise (grafana dashboard: ci/per-prompt-gating) -> enable on protected branches. Feature is opt-in via repo-level gating config.

References: Linear ENG-2345 for gating feature request, ENG-2450 for metric definitions, SUP-4532 for customer-reported missing prompt-level alerts.

Notes: This change keeps the existing per-suite gating behaviour as the default. Per-prompt thresholds must be explicitly configured. The payloads are small and encrypted in transit; no sensitive data leaves Redwood production unless the repo opt-in is enabled.
